preconditions: A session paired once; both applications are then terminated without unwinding and restarted; the previous pairing token is replayed.
expected_result: The previous token is refused with token_invalid; the residue scans for session_key, pairing_token, fingerprint and pairing_record are empty in both cases.
steps: Pair once and capture the session key, pairing token and fingerprint as hex before teardown.
Run residue_scan.py with --root <app-data> and the captured --needle values (after_session_end).
Terminate the desktop application with Stop-Process -Force and the mobile application with adb shell am force-stop, so neither unwinds.
Restart both applications and replay the previous token; it must be refused.
Re-run the identical scan command with --restart-observed (after_application_restart).
Confirm both inspections name the same method and coverage and report no artefacts.
